Tiny Trails: Space

A calm tracing game for ages 3 to 6. Follow a glowing path across little planets and meet the star at the end.

Coming soon to phones and tablets.

For parents

What's free
Free Play, the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds, and the explorers Astro and Zog.
One-time unlock
Every explorer and all 10 worlds. No subscription.
For grown-ups
Made for little hands. No ads, nothing to sign up for. Privacy policy.

How it plays

  • Trace the path with a finger. The trail lights up as the explorer moves.
  • Free Play plus the Sun, Earth, and Moon worlds are included from the start.
  • Astro and Zog are free. The other explorers are part of the one-time unlock.
  • Play again whenever you like. The path is the whole adventure.
